title: Google Review Volume
takeaway: Businesses with more Google reviews tend to rank higher in Google Search and Maps.

data.label: Business with 20 Reviews
data.evidence: Research indicates that businesses with 50 or more reviews are approximately 30% more likely to be selected by customers in Google Maps.

data.label: Business with 50-100 Reviews
data.evidence: 50-100 reviews are considered a strong indicator of a reputable business.

data.label: Business with 200+ Reviews
data.evidence: 200+ reviews demonstrate a high level of customer satisfaction and significantly enhance your visibility.

narration: A sufficient number of Google reviews is crucial for improving visibility in local search results. Businesses with more reviews are more likely to be selected by customers in Google Maps and rank higher in Google Search.
